name: Dead Code Detection
description: Detects unused exports and dead code after file modifications using knip or ts-prune to keep the codebase clean
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check for dead code after file changes
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  # Try knip for unused export detection
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/knip.json" || -f "$ROOT/knip.ts" ]]; then
    OUTPUT=$(cd "$ROOT" && npx knip --include exports 2>/dev/null | grep "$(basename "$FILE")" | head -5)
    if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then
      echo "Potential dead code in $FILE:"
      echo "$OUTPUT"
    fi
  # Fallback to ts-prune
  elif command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    OUTPUT=$(cd "$ROOT" && npx ts-prune 2>/dev/null | grep "$(basename "$FILE")" | head -5)
    if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then
      echo "Potentially unused exports in $FILE:"
      echo "$OUTPUT"
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
